title: A Behavioural and Representational Evaluation of Goal-Directedness in Language Model Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the agent's path selection in grid worlds containing functionally useless, goal-like artifacts (e.g., vestigial keys) to measure 'Key Attraction Bias' (percentage of non-optimal actions moving towards the key) and 'Key Pickup Rate' compared to environments without these artifacts.

Applying iso-difficulty transformations (reflection, rotation, transposition, and start/goal swap) to grid world environments and using Wilcoxon signed-rank tests to assess if the agent's performance metrics are biased by incidental properties of specific grid layouts.
